'''''Optitron''''' was a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] ship in the service of the [[Imperial Department of Redesign]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Kassihm]] hijacked the ship, and used it for his own purposes.
